stories.title: Council rule restricting councillor contact with MSs and MPs raised in Senedd
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has told its own elected councillors they must not contact Members of the Senedd or MPs directly without permission from the chief executive. stories.title: Government and Met Office join Chester Zoo talks on fixing ‘misleading’ rain forecasts
stories.summary: The Met Office, government officials and the heads of 16 of the UK’s biggest visitor attractions meet at Chester Zoo on Monday to discuss how weather forecasts are displayed to the public. The summit follows a warning issued in March that misleading rain icons on weather apps could be costing some attractions up to £137,000

stories.title: Large scale response to North Wales wildfires ongoing
stories.summary: Firefighters remain in attendance at a number of wildfire and grass fire incidents across North Wales this morning. stories.title: Flintshire roadworks round-up: what’s closed and where this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire are facing road closures and temporary traffic lights at dozens of locations this week, with two roads in Ewloe closed overnight by the same contractor. stories.title: Hot weather prompts fire warning over discarded cigarettes
stories.summary: A warning has been issued urging people to dispose of cigarettes safely after a number of fires across North Wales were believed to have been caused by discarded smoking materials.
